findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Dish machine observed with no measurable sanitizer concentration. CORRECTED- PIC primed the machine and changed the sanitizer jug. Sanitizer observed at 100ppm.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (50-200ppm), and pH (10). [P]

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment: Observed ice scoop stored with handle touching the ice. Corrected. Ice scoop was repositioned to prevent bare hand contact with food.  3-304.12

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Cold water nozzle on hand washing sink next to dish machine does not properly adjust. Repair plumbing.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Obsrved a bag of powder in dry storage area to be unlabeled. Label powder with proper name.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed mushroom stuffing, weiners, pasta salad, and gravy with no date marking in the walk in cooler. Date mark food within 24 hours of opening.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
1) Observed bulk flour container in dry storage area to be uncovered. Cover flour. 2) Observed multiple boxes on the floor of the walk in freezer and walk in cooler. Store items 6 inches or higher off the floor.3)Observed coffee filters unprotected. Store coffee filters in a covered bin.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed the scoop handle in contact with the bulk container of powdered sugar. Store handle extended out of food.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1)can opener with food debris 2) deli slicer with dried food debris. Wash, rinse, and sanitize food contact surfaces.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following non food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1)prep table next to two pan sink/cans with food debris 2) duke ovens interior an exterior with what appears to be grease and good debris. Wash non food contact areas.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
1)Observed duct tape on drain pipe under the two compartment sink and under three compartment sink. Remove duct tape from drain pipes. 2) Observed a paper towel plugging the hand sink in the dishwasher area causing it to drain slowly. Unclog sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment:
Observed a hat and sunglasses on top of a mayonaise on shelves in the kitchen. Proive a proper area for employee belongings.
750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
Observed multiple chemical bottles to be unlabled. Properly label chemical bottles. Employee labeled all chemical bottles with proper names. -CORRECTED
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed a mop being stored in mop bucket. Invert mop or hang mop to dry when not in use.
750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
Observed no food managers during food provide. Certified food manager shall be present at all times of food preparation.
750-540 All Category I facilities must employ an adequate number of  Licensed Food Service Sanitation Managers to have one present at all times food is being prepared to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide an adequate number of  Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
There were pots stored on wire shelves by the walk-in coolers that were food side up.
Invert the pots or cover the shelves above with plastic liners.
750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Two bulbs were burned out in the hood over the convection ovens.
Replace the bulbs.
750-1230(a) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide at least 20 foot-candles of light on all food preparation surfaces and at equipment or utensil washing areas.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text: 750.1120 - A) Employee restroom door does not have a self closer on it. Install a self closer on the employee restroom door. B) Toilet and handsink in the employee restroom were soiled. Toilet facilities shall be kept clean. Clean all restrooms daily/as needed and maintain them clean.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 Exit door on west side of kitchen had gaps in the corners where light was visible. Door sweep was replaced during the inspection to correct the issue. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of pests. **Check doors and repair sweeps and weather stripping as needed to maintain the doors tight fitting and vermin proof.**

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: A) Get covered waste cans for public and employee restrooms. B) Install self-closer on employee restroom.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: A) Caulk the urinal to the wall in the men's restroom. B) Paint the employee restroom door.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - A) Shelves and fan cover in walkin cooler were soiled. B) Old mouse droppings were observed in dry storage area on a ledge. Clean the shelves and fan cover in walkin cooler. Clean the ledge in the dry storage area where old droppings were observed and all general surfaces throughout.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Corner by garage door had evidence of old mouse activity (area had been gnawed). The area was not open to the outside. Properly repair the area by the garage door. B) Floor in walkin cooler in corners and around floor drain were soiled. Drain cover was also off. Clean the floor and around the drain in the walkin cooler. Put the cover back on the drain. C) A few old mouse droppings were observed on the floor in the dry storage area. Clean the floor in the dry storage area.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed a dented can.  Discard or set aside for return.  Corrected: Can was set aside for return.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe fro human consumption.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Observed a plastic storage container of utensils with debris in the bottom of the container.  Clean and sanitize the container and contents.
750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed cardboard used to line a shelf.  Discontinue use.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed debris and a spider web in the dessert pantry.  Clean the pantry.
